title: N -W F P Rivers Protection Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Rivers Protection Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

N
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE RIVERS PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Rivers Protection Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 9th May, 2002]
No. Legis.1(6)/2001/3012/3591,
dated 9-5-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Rivers Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. III of 2002

N
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE RIVERS PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Rivers Protection Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 9th May, 2002]
No. Legis.1(6)/2001/3012/3591,
dated 9-5-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of N.-W.F.P.
Ordinance No. III of 2002.---In the North-West Frontier Province Rivers
Protection Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. III of 2002):
(a) in the last
but one para. of the preamble, for the word "circumstance", the word
"circumstances" shall be substituted; and
(b) in section
1, in subsection (1), for the figure "2001", the figure
"2002" shall be substituted.
